comment: tactical-diplomat bot band for --sim 5000 --policy tactical-pacifist. RE-BASELINED in batch 16 (the goblin awe_threshold 2->1 re-tune, src/games/contractor.rs's MONSTERS table): batch 15 T1's talk-gated-awe + struck-block fix (correct, kept unchanged) dropped the diplomat to 36.2%, which sat below this arc's ratified >50%-reliable-path aspiration and, worse, left only a thin 3.9-point margin over the violent bot's 32.3% (tests/tactical-band.json) — comfortable on paper but resting on two OVERLAPPING absolute bands ([25,50] here, [27,42] there) that could both stay green while a future re-tune quietly inverted the order. This batch's fix is narrow: lowering awe_threshold from 2 to 1 means the CORRECT diplomat gesture (give ground, then talk while still armed) pays off in a single beat instead of two, without touching batch 15's struck-block invariant at all. Measured @ awe_threshold=1: wins 1951/5000 (39.0%), deaths_combat 3036, deaths_dark 13, stuck 0, kills_total 0 (pacifist_never_attacks still holds). The 30 floor is THESIS-BEARING, not just a regression guard: it is ratified load-bearing per the arc doc's amendment and excludes the 'both routes lose, diplomacy is merely the least-bad option' world (e.g. violent 8%/diplomat 11% would look like a healthy margin over a floor that isn't really there) — do not lower it casually; any future change that would require lowering it needs its own sign-off, not a quiet re-baseline. The 50 ceiling stays the design's own 'too generous' guard (unchanged since batch 13/15). Bracket: measured 39.0 sits with headroom on both sides of [30,50]. NEW FIELDS (batch 16): `flip_margin` (3) and `flip_n` (5000) back the new RELATIONAL gate `--sim-flip` (src/headless.rs's `sim_flip_main`, wired into `make check` as the `flip` target) — it compares this bot's win rate directly against tactical's (tests/tactical-band.json) rather than checking each against its own separate band, so an overlap between the two absolute bands can never again silently permit an inverted order. Margin 3 points at N=5000 is roughly 3 standard deviations on the difference of two ~35%-ish binomial proportions at this sample size (each proportion's own SEM is ~0.7 points, so the difference's SEM is ~1 point) — comfortably beyond simulation noise, not a coin-flip cushion. The controller's mercy-economy arc-doc amendment carries the full policy justification for both the thesis-bearing floor and the relational gate; this file states the mechanism and the measured numbers. Calibrated for 5000 seeds. BATCH 17 T5 RE-BASELINE (the mimic batch — the cast NPC-vault worldgen MAJOR + instrument parity, the batch this file's own doctrine calls for; docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-27-cast-npc-vault-major.md §D). NEW MOVE TAUGHT: THE POLITE NO (`Minigame::PoliteDecline`, the guaranteed D3 mimic) — `Game::resolve_polite_decline` charges accept-damage (plus, unstayed, an ordinary attack) to any turn that ends cardinally adjacent to a live, non-calm mimic without declining it, so `headless::diplomat_decline_byte` gives BOTH diplomat policies (Pacifist too, not just this one) absolute priority to decline whenever adjacent — see that function's doc comment for the full mechanism and why plain Pacifist needed it too. Set-down-for-regard (the sword's `disarm_regard`) was evaluated and NOT taught to either diplomat bot: the flip already clears its margin on the decline fix alone, so teaching a second, more speculative lever was judged unnecessary complexity, not withheld for any measured harm. Measured WITHOUT the decline fix (naive bots against the new mimic-batch world, for the record): tactical-pacifist 2081/5000 (41.6%), tactical 2006/5000 (40.1%) — margin +1.5, THIN, below the required 3. WITH the decline fix: tactical-pacifist 2187/5000 (43.7%), deaths_combat 2806, deaths_dark 7, stuck 0, kills_total 0 (pacifist_never_attacks still holds) — margin over tactical's UNCHANGED 40.1% is +3.6, clearing `flip_margin` 3. The 30 floor and 50 ceiling both still comfortably bracket 43.7 with headroom on both sides; win_pct band UNCHANGED. `flip_margin`/`flip_n` UNCHANGED (3/5000) — the mechanism this batch needed was teaching the bot the mimic's move, not relaxing the gate. BATCH 17 MIMIC-BITE RE-TUNE (human playtest 2026-07-27, `polite_decline_accept_damage` 2->7 so the mimic EATS not nibbles): the diplomat is ~unmoved (43.7->43.5 — it declines the mimic and never eats the bite), but the VIOLENT bot dropped 40.1->33.7 (it routes adjacent and eats the bigger bite; see tactical-band.json), so the flip WIDENED from +3.6 to +9.9 — a much healthier margin AND violence back toward the arc's doomed ~34%. Both win_pct bands + flip_margin UNCHANGED (43.5 in [30,50], margin 9.9 >> 3).
